name: widget-standard
title: Widget Standard
description: Define a proto-backed standard for scenario UIs to expose coarse-grained, inline-renderable sections (settings panels, CRUD forms, entity detail pages, dashboard sections) as `widgets` that agent-inbox can surface inside a chat. Extends iframe-bridge with a widget-manifest handshake and a scoped-render directive so a scenario UI can render widget X in isolation. Authoring pattern: a single `ui/src/widgets.ts` source-of-truth file declares each widget (id, description, category, tags); React code imports from it and applies `data-widget` attributes to the corresponding DOM boundaries. Static build-time extraction walks the AST inside each data-widget boundary to produce the embedding corpus for retrieval. Scenario-auditor rule compares declared widgets, source usages, and runtime iframe-bridge manifest — any drift fails. Prompt-manager skill `widget-authoring` + template stub make adoption cheap. Reuses / extends the BAS e2e selector pattern where feasible.
